meta.title: Vandana's 90-Day Challenge
meta.datesNote: Dates assume Day 1 = startDate. If you shift the start, recompute date = startDate + (day - 1).

rules: Never zero: a Minimum Day counts as showed up
Never double up: missed work goes to the next catch-up day (every 7th day)
Missed 3+ days: continue from where you stopped and shift the end date; it is 90 working days
Review on Days 30, 60, 90: cut scope, not sleep
